game: God of War: Sons of Sparta
project: God of War: Sons of Sparta PC Port
approach: Original PS4 x86-64 game code running natively on Windows and Linux through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4
notes: Public native PC release v0.1.1, a bugfix release over v0.1.0: optional cheats with an F10 in-game menu (God Mode, Infinite Spartan Spirit, Infinite Magic, Damage Multiplier, Movement Speed, Jump Height, Add 1000 Blood Orbs, Add 10 Upgrade Materials; all Off by default), Linux and Steam Deck startup crash fix, support for processors with AVX but without AVX2, Windows game installation in long folder paths, Intel GPU compatibility improvements and stronger crash diagnostics. Windows x64 is the primary target. Experimental Linux and Steam Deck AppImage: v0.1.1 includes fixes based on reports from real Linux and Steam Deck systems, but runtime coverage is still more limited than on Windows. True Ultrawide Hor+ for 21:9 and 32:9. Rendering up to 4K. Frame rates up to 240 FPS and Unlimited. The Pit of Agonies and Hermes Mode are unlockable from the beginning. Original local two-player co-op with Kratos and Deimos in The Pit. Skip Intro. Xbox and PlayStation controller support. TRG launcher with direct installation from the user's own compatible PS4 package. No game files are included.
